控制模式架构

相关源文件

以下文件被用作生成本 wiki 页面时的上下文：

  • src/inference_service/inference_service/lerobot_policy_node.py

  • src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm_rgbd.yaml

目的与范围

本文档描述 IB-Robot 的控制模式架构。该架构允许单个机器人配置支持三种不同运行范式：teleoperation、AI model inference 和 motion planning。每种模式使用不同 controllers 和执行策略，但都汇聚到 ros2_control 提供的同一硬件抽象层。

该架构由 robot_config package 驱动，robot_config 是 mode definitions、controller sets 和 execution parameters 的 single source of truth。

来源：src/robot_config/launch/robot.launch.py:1-11, src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:69-137

概览

IB-Robot 实现三种控制模式，以适配不同使用场景和 AI model architectures：

Mode

主要使用场景

控制频率

Controller Type

执行接口

teleop

人工示范采集

50.0 Hz

Position controllers

Direct topic streaming

model_inference

端到端模仿学习，ACT、Diffusion Policy

20.0 Hz

Position controllers

Action dispatch with temporal smoothing

moveit_planning

目标条件策略，VoxPoser、VLM

Variable

Trajectory controllers

Action server (FollowJointTrajectory)

控制模式在 launch time 确定，并驱动整个系统栈，从要 spawn 的 controllers 到要实例化的 nodes。

来源：src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:71-137, src/robot_config/launch/robot.launch.py:74-81

控制模式选择架构

控制模式选择由 robot.launch.py 处理。它解析 mode name，然后使用 generate_ros2_control_nodes 识别所需 controllers。

Title: Mode Resolution and Controller Selection

        graph TB
    subgraph "Configuration_Layer"
        YAML["so101_single_arm.yaml"]
        DEFAULT["default_control_mode: 'model_inference'<br/>(line 64)"]
        MODES["control_modes section<br/>(lines 69-137)"]
        
        YAML --> DEFAULT
        YAML --> MODES
    end
    
    subgraph "Launch_Layer_[robot.launch.py]"
        PARAM["Launch Argument:<br/>control_mode"]
        LOADER["load_robot_config_dict()"]
        BUILDER["generate_ros2_control_nodes()"]
        
        PARAM --> BUILDER
        LOADER --> MODES
        MODES --> BUILDER
    end
    
    subgraph "Code_Logic_[control.py]"
        FIND_MODE{"Mode in<br/>control_modes?"}
        GET_CTRL["Extract controller_names"]
        
        BUILDER --> FIND_MODE
        FIND_MODE -->|"Yes"| GET_CTRL
        GET_CTRL --> SPAWN["generate_controller_spawners()"]
    end
    
    subgraph "ROS_2_Runtime"
        SPAWN --> TELEOP_CTRL["teleop:<br/>arm_position_controller"]
        SPAWN --> MODEL_CTRL["model_inference:<br/>arm_position_controller"]
        SPAWN --> MOVEIT_CTRL["moveit_planning:<br/>arm_trajectory_controller"]
    end

控制模式选择遵循以下优先级：

  1. Command line override，通过 control_mode:=<mode> launch argument src/robot_config/launch/robot.launch.py:74。

  2. Default mode，由 YAML default_control_mode field 指定 src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:64。

  3. Validation：generate_ros2_control_nodes 函数会根据 control_modes dictionary 验证 mode src/robot_config/robot_config/launch_builders/control.py:135-157。

来源：src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:64-70, src/robot_config/launch/robot.launch.py:74-81, src/robot_config/robot_config/launch_builders/control.py:135-157

Teleoperation 模式

目的

Teleoperation 模式用于数据采集中的直接人工控制。它将 input devices，leader arms、gamepads 或 VR，高频透传到 robot hardware。

配置

teleop:
  controllers:
    - joint_state_broadcaster
    - arm_position_controller
    - gripper_position_controller
  inference:
    enabled: false
  executor:
    type: topic
    mode: teleop
    control_frequency: 50.0

数据流

generate_teleop_nodes 函数创建 teleoperation 基础设施。在该模式下，action_dispatcher 会被绕过，或以低延迟 “teleop” 模式使用，将 input device topics 直接映射到 controller command topics。

Title: Teleop Data Flow (Code Entities)

        graph LR
    subgraph "Teleop_Input"
        LEADER["Leader Arm Node"]
        XBOX["Xbox Controller Node"]
    end
    
    subgraph "ROS_Topics"
        CMD_ARM["/arm_position_controller/commands"]
        CMD_GRIP["/gripper_position_controller/commands"]
    end
    
    subgraph "ros2_control"
        CTRL["arm_position_controller<br/>(JointGroupPositionController)"]
        HW["SO101SystemHardware<br/>(so101_hardware)"]
    end
    
    LEADER --> CMD_ARM
    XBOX --> CMD_GRIP
    CMD_ARM --> CTRL
    CTRL --> HW

来源：src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:71-85, src/robot_config/launch/robot.launch.py:120

Model Inference 模式

目的

该模式支持端到端 learned policies，例如 ACT。它使用 inference_service 生成 action chunks，并使用 action_dispatcher 平滑和执行这些 chunks。

配置

model_inference:
  controllers:
    - joint_state_broadcaster
    - arm_position_controller
    - gripper_position_controller
  inference:
    enabled: true
    model: so101_act_rknn
    action_server: /inference/dispatch
  executor:
    type: topic
    mode: model_inference
    watermark_threshold: 50
    control_frequency: 20.0

Monolithic vs. Distributed Execution

推理流水线支持两种执行模式：

  • Monolithic：LeRobotPolicyNode 在单一进程中处理 preprocessing、GPU inference 和 postprocessing src/inference_service/inference_service/lerobot_policy_node.py:7-12。

  • Distributed：LeRobotPolicyNode 作为 edge proxy，通过 /preprocessed/batch 和 /inference/action topics 将 GPU inference 卸载给 pure_inference_node src/inference_service/inference_service/lerobot_policy_node.py:13-25。

Title: Inference Mode Execution Flow

        graph TB
    subgraph "Action_Dispatch_[action_dispatcher_node.py]"
        DISPATCH["ActionDispatcherNode"]
        EXEC["TopicExecutor"]
    end

    subgraph "Edge_[lerobot_policy_node.py]"
        PRE["TensorPreprocessor"]
        POST["TensorPostprocessor"]
    end

    subgraph "Cloud_[pure_inference_node.py]"
        PURE["PureInferenceEngine"]
    end

    DISPATCH -->|DispatchInfer Action| PRE
    PRE -->|/preprocessed/batch| PURE
    PURE -->|/inference/action| POST
    POST -->|Action Chunk| DISPATCH
    DISPATCH --> EXEC
    EXEC -->|/commands| ROS2_CTRL["ros2_control"]

来源：src/inference_service/inference_service/lerobot_policy_node.py:7-33, src/action_dispatch/action_dispatch/action_dispatcher_node.py:43-52, src/robot_config/robot_config/launch_builders/execution.py:157-165

MoveIt Planning 模式

目的

MoveIt planning 模式支持带避障的高层运动规划。它面向 target-pose commands，而不是高频 joint streams。

配置

moveit_planning:
  controllers:
    - joint_state_broadcaster
    - arm_trajectory_controller
    - gripper_trajectory_controller
  inference:
    enabled: false
  executor:
    type: action
    mode: moveit_planning

数据流

  • Trajectory Controllers：使用 arm_trajectory_controller 和 gripper_trajectory_controller 执行规划路径 src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:130-131。

  • Action Executor：dispatcher 或 high-level task node 使用 ActionExecutor 对接 trajectory controllers 提供的 FollowJointTrajectory action server src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:135。

来源：src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:125-137

统一硬件汇聚

三种模式全部汇聚到 ros2_control hardware interface。

  1. Hardware Plugin：so101_hardware/SO101SystemHardware plugin 通过 ros2_control configuration 加载 src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:164。

  2. Controller Manager：robot.launch.py 根据 use_sim flag 启动真实 ros2_control_node 或 Gazebo gz_ros2_control plugin src/robot_config/launch/robot.launch.py:12-14。

  3. Common Interface：无论模式如何，hardware 都期望 JointState feedback 和 position/trajectory commands。controllers_config 文件定义这些 controllers 如何映射到底层 hardware joints src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:179。

来源：src/robot_config/launch/robot.launch.py:1-20, src/robot_config/config/robots/so101_single_arm.yaml:163-187, src/robot_config/robot_config/launch_builders/control.py:165-180
